text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. One important idea is responsive design, which means the app looks good and works well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, while cross-platform apps work on several systems, saving time and money. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where users can download them. Finally, performance matters a lot: a good app should load quickly, run smoothly, and not use too much battery. These choices affect how successful an app will be.
